title: ek-api project spec
description: A request to generate a project, and the provenance (template-origin.json) of a generated one. Generated by `ek schema` from catalog/.

template.description: The template, by identity or short name.

version.description: The template package version that generated, or should generate, the project.

name.description: The project name, used for namespaces, project files and the solution.

preset.description: A named starting point. Options given next to it win over its values.

options.description: Template options. An option left out takes the value a rule needs, or its default.

auth.description: Authentication. Every choice except 'none' needs a database, and turns PostgreSQL on when --db is none.

db.description: Database, through EF Core with migrations, audit history and a compose deployment.

email.description: Email delivery. 'smtp' adds an email transport (SMTP with MailKit, or the log in development) and templated messages.

jobs.description: Background jobs. 'hangfire' needs a database, and turns PostgreSQL on when --db is none.

storage.description: File storage. 's3' adds uploads, downloads and signed links on any S3-compatible storage, and needs a database: it turns PostgreSQL on when --db is none.

documents.description: Add CSV and Excel import and export of notes, and a PDF report.

realtime.description: Add real-time channels: a SignalR hub, server-sent events and raw WebSockets, carrying note changes to connected clients.

notifications.description: Add stored in-app notifications with read status and per-user preferences, delivered by email, mobile push (FCM, APNs) and SMS (Twilio). Needs sign-in: turns Identity on when --auth is none.

webhooks.description: Add incoming webhooks (signature checks, duplicate detection, queued processing) and outgoing webhooks (signed deliveries, retries, a delivery log). Needs a database: turns PostgreSQL on when --db is none.

worker.description: Add a worker project that runs the API's jobs in its own process and container. Implies --jobs hangfire.

aspire.description: Add a .NET Aspire AppHost that starts the API, the worker and the database for local development.

agents.description: Guidance files for AI coding agents.
